_seed: DEMO SEED DATA. A fictional patient's itemized ER statement, written to look like a real self-pay statement. The hospital is a real 501(c)(3) (Stanford Health Care) so the research step can find its real financial-assistance policy and price-transparency file, but this bill, account number and patient are invented. Planted errors are listed in _plantedErrors for tests; the audit code never reads that field.

_plantedErrors.why: Initial IV push billed twice on the same date for the same charge; 96374 is reportable once per encounter (later pushes are 96375).
Level-5 ER visit for a ~3h17m visit with no critical care, discharged home; level 4 (99284) fits. Stake = 30% of the line (Medicare OPPS level-4/level-5 ratio ~0.70).
Creatinine 82565, BUN 84520 and glucose 82947 billed separately although all are inside the comprehensive metabolic panel 80053 billed the same day.
